APPROVE
The extraction preserves the original logic and evaluation order (the `||` short-circuit means `ReadListEntry` runs only for PODS/DEPENDENCIES lines, and `entry` is definitely assigned after the `continue`), and it removes roughly 10 points of nested complexity, bringing the method to about 15. I couldn't find the source file on this machine, though, so I couldn't build it or confirm that `resolved` and `direct` really are `Dictionary<string, string>` and `List<string>`; if `direct` is a `HashSet<string>`, the build will fail.
